result:
The proposed answer of 4 doesn't hold up, as far as I can tell. The degree formula given is asserted without derivation, and the claim that 4-valent vertices "always suffice" is stated as a theorem without support. I recall the sharp bound in this setting as 6, not 4, but I can't verify that from memory, so my confidence is only moderate.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 3
